description: Ministry of Transportation (MOT) Drainage Appliance is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Construction and Maintenance. A Drainage Appliance is an apparatus (that has not been described as a culvert), or earth works, designed to facilitate the movement of water in a controlled manner. Drainage Appliance include some appliances/earth works that work in conjunction with culverts. It is a Point feature. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Construction and Maintenance. Its tags are DA, MOT, MOT asset, MOT inventory, drainage appliance. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
